//: flair#1944 round 9 — type-checks packages/cursor-wake-runner's TEST directory. The package tsconfig.json includes only `src`, and the root tsconfig.test.check.json includes only the ROOT `test/**`, so nothing type-checked these tests: a `@ts-expect-error` guard (e.g. on `WakeDeps` carrying no `__test` seam) could rot silently — restore the typed field and the unused directive would go unnoticed. This config checks `src` + `test` together (noEmit; the test files import `.ts` specifiers, hence allowImportingTsExtensions). Wired into CI by the typecheck-strict job.
